description: This Java class 'PropertiesResourceLoader' provides functionality to load properties files from a specified resource location and class loader, aggregating key-value pairs into a map where each key maps to a list of string values. It handles resource enumeration, property parsing, and ensures that duplicate entries are filtered out, returning an unmodifiable list for each key.

classes.name: PropertiesResourceLoader
classes.description: A utility class with static method 'load' for loading and aggregating properties resources.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads properties files from the specified resource location using the given class loader, returning a map of property keys to lists of trimmed, distinct values.
